title: Fastly Named a Leader in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Edge Distribution Platforms
summary: Fastly, Inc., a leader in global edge cloud platforms, today announced it has been named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Edge Distribution Platforms.
body_markdown:
*Fastly's Developer-centric Edge Cloud Platform Enables Organizations to Build, Secure, and Deliver Apps on a Single Platform*


SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Nov. 12, 2026-- Fastly, Inc.(NASDAQ: FSLY), a leader in global edge cloud platforms, today announced it has been named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Edge Distribution Platforms.


Edge distribution platforms bring compute, security, content, and API delivery, and analytics together in a globally distributed edge cloud infrastructure. As applications and AI move closer to users and data, buyers need a unified platform to improve performance, strengthen security, and deploy and scale globally without stitching together multiple vendors.


“We've seen AI use cases expand on our network, from agents interacting with our customers' applications to code generation, model distribution, and content authenticity,” said Kelly Shortridge, Chief Product Officer at Fastly. “Enterprise platform teams need an edge that adapts as fast as their traffic does, and we believe being named a Leader reflects the strength of Fastly’s platform in meeting those needs.”


Fastly’s edge distribution platform delivers a developer-centric architecture that supports complex application logic at the edge with low latency. It can also support emerging application requirements such as real-time request processing, observability, and security enforcement, creating a developer experience that customers value for its ease of use and low operational burden.


Fastly continues to invest in its Edge AI services, including[AI Runtime Control](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fastly.com%2Fproducts%2Fai-runtime-control&esheet=54640342&newsitemid=20261112790387&lan=en-US&anchor=AI+Runtime+Control&index=1&md5=047c2158fe140f5caa2976d5bfa6d866) with semantic caching and[ContentGuard](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fastly.com%2Fdocumentation%2Fguides%2Fsecurity%2Fbot-management%2Fcontentguard%2Fabout-contentguard%2F&esheet=54640342&newsitemid=20261112790387&lan=en-US&anchor=ContentGuard&index=2&md5=0e16413dccba2ee559313eb1248f01f3) , which were announced earlier this year. It is also investing in additional API governance, AI WAF capabilities, and intelligent model routing. Earlier this year, Fastly was also[named](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2Furl%3Fq%3Dhttps%3A%2F%2Finvestors.fastly.com%2Fnews-releases%2Fnews-release-details%2Ffastly-named-2026-gartnerr-peer-insightstm-customers-choice-edge%26sa%3DD%26source%3Ddocs%26ust%3D1792772553386144%26usg%3DAOvVaw2fj7_pfJqosKt6i-si2Ar5&esheet=54640342&newsitemid=20261112790387&lan=en-US&anchor=named&index=3&md5=ca985aa282e8dca81a3d611f8e32ed1d) a 2026 Gartner® Peer Insights™ Customers' Choicefor Edge Distribution Platforms. Fastly is one of only ** two vendors to be named a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ ** and a[2026 Gartner® Peer Insights™ Customers’ Choice for Edge Distribution Platforms](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.fastly.com%2Fnews-releases%2Fnews-release-details%2Ffastly-named-2026-gartnerr-peer-insightstm-customers-choice-edge&esheet=54640342&newsitemid=20261112790387&lan=en-US&anchor=2026+Gartner%26%23174%3B+Peer+Insights%26%238482%3B+Customers%26%238217%3B+Choice+for+Edge+Distribution+Platforms&index=4&md5=ebe8111e0740558ac595044477178c58) . For more information on the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Edge Distribution Platforms, please visit[www.fastly.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fastly.com%2Fresources%2Freport%2F2026-gartner-magic-quadrant-edge-distribution-platforms&esheet=54640342&newsitemid=20261112790387&lan=en-US&anchor=www.fastly.com&index=5&md5=238d7a2fc46e16e797362963ea6aa445) .
